name: MusicQuiz
description: Music Quiz is a game where players can guess songs locally. It allows you to customise the game and play in multiplayer mode.
author: Rafael Molleja Jiménez

scripts.compile-all: pnpm clear-sqlite-build && pnpm clear-build && pnpm compile-windows && pnpm compile-mac && pnpm compile-linux
scripts.compile-windows: pnpm clear-sqlite-build && pnpm build && npm_config_target_platform=win32 npm_config_target_arch=x64 electron-builder install-app-deps --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && electron-builder -w --x64
scripts.compile-linux: pnpm clear-sqlite-build && pnpm build && npm_config_target_platform=linux npm_config_target_arch=x64 electron-builder install-app-deps --platform=linux --arch=x64 && electron-builder -l
scripts.compile-mac: pnpm clear-sqlite-build &&pnpm build && npm_config_target_platform=darwin npm_config_target_arch=arm64 electron-builder install-app-deps --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && electron-builder -m

entry.Name: Music Quiz
entry.Comment: Music Quiz is a game where players can guess songs locally. It allows you to customise the game and play in multiplayer mode.
